brightport_allares0.m: Please don't bother the cooks. We are very busy today. We've got some big orders for the festival down in Sullengard.
r: Eatloni told me to see you.
That's nice. But I don't care. See you later.

brightport_allares1.m: Today we're swamped, so we'll pay you a full day's wage for just a bit of work. Go down to the storage area and see what Delon asks of you.

brightport_allares10.m: And now let's discuss your payment. 50 gold for the bakery work.

brightport_allares12.m: And 100 for bringing us the apples. Any complaints?
r: Just give me the gold already.

brightport_allares13.m: OK, here you go. Don't spend it all in useless shops. Ideally buy some pastries at our bakery.

brightport_allares2.m: Very good, very good! Go down to the storage room and speak with Delon. You two will be working together.

r: I brought the apples to Eatloni, he'll have them brought in soon.
Delon said there was an apple delivery that was supposed to arrive but didn't.
I'm still looking for those apples.

brightport_allares4.m: Have you brought me the deer meat?

brightport_allares5.m: Very good, you've convinced me of your capabilities. Please talk to Eatloni outside, he was in charge of the apple delivery and should know more.

brightport_allares6.m: Yes it should have arrived quite a while ago, usually they are on time. That is terrible for today of all days as we have a big order to fulfill in the next few days.
r: I could go help look for it.

brightport_allares7.m: Hmm, maybe you could. But I'm a little hesitant. If the merchant went missing, that could mean danger, and I don't want to be responsible for you.
r: Don't worry, I'm an experienced adventurer.

brightport_allares8.m: You do have some shiny equipment on you, which shows me you're a bit experienced, but I'd rather you prove it by bringing me something tough to get. Some venison, or in other words, deer meat. And yes I will pay you, it's just that it's been tough to get lately.

brightport_allares9.m: Very good $playername, you've been our most useful temporary worker so far.

brightport_allares_apples.m: That is good, $playername, but not quite right. It is Eatloni you were supposed to deliver them to, there is a proper procedure for everything.

brightport_allares_end.m: Hello. You've done good work today. Saved us quite a bit of time.

brightport_bakery.1: I've started some work for Allares at the bakery in Brightport. He asked me to help Delon down in the storage area.
brightport_bakery.5: I spoke with Delon and he's a real slacker. He wants me to do all sorts of work, all by myself.
brightport_bakery.10: He told me to start by sweeping the floor, and to do that I must find a broom.
brightport_bakery.15: The floor's all swept. I did it all by myself. Delon's "help" was more of a nuisance.
brightport_bakery.16: No wonder it got so quiet. Delon disappeared to sleep on some sacks. And now I have a new task, to sift through some flour.
brightport_bakery.19: I've sifted through all of the flour.
brightport_bakery.20: One last errand. An apple delivery hasn't arrived. I should ask Allares about it.
brightport_bakery.22: Allares refuses to accept my help until I prove my capabilities by bringing him one piece of deer meat.
brightport_bakery.23: After bringing the deer meat to Allares, he accepted my help, I should speak to Eatloni outside.
brightport_bakery.25: According to Eatloni, the order of 30 apples never arrived. I should visit Deebo's Orchard to check if the order had been picked up.
brightport_bakery.30: I went to see Deebo at the orchard. Apparently the merchant sent by Eatloni already picked up the apples.
brightport_bakery.35: I found some half-eaten apples in the woods north of the Duleian road.
brightport_bakery.40: I found two crates of apples. One was intact, but the other was empty. Did the mountain cats attack the merchant for food to feed their cubs?
brightport_bakery.45: I paid for a new shipment out of my own pocket. Deebo promised to hurry his workers and get them picked quickly. I should receive them from the orchard supervisor.
brightport_bakery.50: I received the apples from Alduan.
brightport_bakery.60: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. He reimbursed me for half the cost. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.65: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.70: I completed all the tasks at the bakery.
